Cargo plane slides off runway in Hong Kong; 2 dead

LOOK: A cargo plane flying from Dubai skidded off the runway into the sea while landing at Hong Kong International Airport, the city's airport operator said on Monday, October 20, with local media reporting the deaths of two people.

The northern runway at the airport is closed after the incident, Hong Kong International Airport said, adding the south and central runways would continue to operate.

The accident occurred around 3:50 AM Manila time, and the airport confirmed the aircraft was carrying an Emirates flight number. Emirates did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.

The four crew members on board were reportedly rescued. Two people who were inside a ground vehicle near the runway that was suspected to have been struck by the aircraft have died, local media reported, citing police. | via Reuters

📷: Reuters
